summary: Castor Maritime filed a 6-K disclosing that on October 8, 2026 it and Toro Corp. amended reciprocal convertible preferred terms held via wholly owned subsidiaries. The earliest conversion date of Castor's 5.00% Series D Cumulative Perpetual Convertible Preferred Shares held by Toro is extended one year, to January 1, 2028, and Toro's 1.00% Series A Fixed Rate Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Convertible Shares held by Castor is extended to March 7, 2028. Both boards approved on the recommendation of special committees of disinterested independent directors; the shared chairman/CEO/CFO creates conflict-management and overhang watchpoints.
